<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4:3">Gen. R. s. 4</cite> <he>כהדין ק׳</he> (sub. <he>דעששיתא</he>) like the oil floating on the water in a lamp; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 5:6">Yalk. ib. 5</cite> <cite ref="S01530"><he>קנדליא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
Esth. R. to I, 3 קַנְדֵּלָה, v. פַּטִּים; a. e.—Pl. (h. form) קַנְדִּילִים; קַנְדִּילִין, קַנְדִּילַיָּא.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">Lam. R. to III, 7</cite> <he>הוה מסדר קנדילי־ה</he> (not <he>מסדרא</he>) prepared his Sabbath lights; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:2:3">Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᵃ</cite> top <he>עביד קַנְדִּילוֹי</he>.
